paper_metadata.title: Enhancing cryogenic tensile properties of CrCoNi medium entropy alloy via heterogeneous microstructure design

evidence.quote: Here we fabricate a heterostructure in CrCoNi medium entropy alloy consisting of deformed substructures (the hard zone) and recrystallized ultrafine/fine grains (the soft zone).

evidence.quote: it is a partial-recrystallized heterostructure, with non-recrystallized zones (NRZs, the red islands) uniformly dispersed in recrystallized zones (RZs, blue matrix).
The volume fraction of NRZs is ~20%.
the size of recrystallized grains ranges from ultrafine scale to a few micrometers, with an average size of about 1 um.
